stories.title: NB Power extends winter disconnection moratorium for vulnerable customers
stories.summary: NB Power has announced that a pilot program, which offered more leniency for vulnerable populations who have difficulty paying their bills, will continue this winter.

stories.title: UNB-led study aims to boost exercise benefits for type 2 diabetes
stories.summary: A research group from the University of New Brunswick is leading a national study they hope will unlock greater health benefits for people living with type 2 diabetes.

stories.title: Watchdog clears N.B. RCMP in shooting death of First Nations man in January
stories.summary: New Brunswick’s police watchdog has cleared an RCMP officer of criminality in the shooting death of an Indigenous man earlier this year.

stories.title: New Brunswick community plans to expropriate land from owner that closed mill
stories.summary: A small New Brunswick community says it plans to expropriate land around a recently closed pulp mill as it looks towards its future.

stories.title: Tracey DeWare appointed New Brunswick chief justice, prime minister says
stories.summary: Tracey DeWare replaces former chief justice Marc Richard, who chose to take on a reduced workload in August.

stories.title: Judge throws out $1-million fine against N.B. seafood company, requests new decision
stories.summary: A federal judge has thrown out a $1-million fine and foreign worker ban against a New Brunswick seafood processing company.

stories.title: Hope for restart grows as Nackawic, N.B. feels effects of mill shutdown
stories.summary: Nearly three weeks after the Nackawic pulp mill shut down in New Brunswick, putting 350 workers out of work, the ripple effects are now reaching local businesses.

stories.title: Remains of N.B. sailor recovered nearly 80 years after plane crash
stories.summary: Nearly 80 years after a two-seat naval fighter crashed in Northern Ireland, the remains of a young man from New Brunswick have been recovered and identified.

stories.title: Weather alerts in effect due to heavy rain across N.S. and parts of N.B., N.L.
stories.summary: Heavy rain is set to hit Nova Scotia and much of New Brunswick and Newfoundland.

stories.title: N.B. government in talks with Quebec firm about restarting idled Nackawic pulp mill
stories.summary: Provincial Natural Resources Minister John Herron issued a statement Friday saying government officials are talking to Arbec Forest Products Inc., based in Saint-Léonard, Que.
